prompt: Ecto with_ties limit redefined interaction requirement
answer:
If `limit` is redefined, `with_ties` must be reapplied.

```elixir
query
|> limit(10)
|> with_ties(true)
|> limit(20)
```

The second `limit(20)` overrides the previous limit, so the `with_ties` setting must be added again:

```elixir
query
|> limit(10)
|> with_ties(true)
|> limit(20)
|> with_ties(true)
```

Also, `with_ties` can only be applied when the query already has a `limit`; otherwise, Ecto raises an error.
